settings.editor: Skincare, makeup and body care chosen one product at a time, for skin that lives in Ugandan sun. Ordered online, delivered across the country.

settings.title: A shelf is easy to fill. Choosing well is the work.

settings.editor: We buy what we would use ourselves, we check where it came from, and we tell you honestly what it does. Nothing arrives here because it trended.

Beauty Crib is an online beauty shop based in Kampala, offering skincare, makeup, hair care, body care and fragrance to customers across Uganda. Every product is sourced genuine and sent out with the kind of advice you would get from someone who actually uses it. Start with a cleanser, build the rest slowly.

settings.description_text: Sourced through channels we can account for, and replaced if anything looks wrong.
Same or next day in Kampala, countrywide by courier.
Pay with MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Visa or Mastercard.
Tell us your skin and we will tell you what to skip.

settings.title: Confidence is quiet. So is good skin.

settings.editor: Counterfeit cosmetics are common here. We would rather list fewer products than list ones we cannot vouch for.
Seventeen cleansers, not seven hundred. Each one exists on the shelf because it answers a specific need.
We explain what a product does, who it suits and when to skip it, including when the answer is do nothing.
A routine should take minutes, not evenings. The best one is the one you will still be doing in June.
Sunscreen is built to resist water, so water alone will not remove it. An oil first, a foam second, and the difference shows up within a week: fewer blackheads, less congestion, calmer skin.
